add.title: Ship the lab
add.description: A real Task in a page's content.

add.title: ✅ Any class can live on /live/
add.text:
The card below is a real **Task**, not a text card. Its own methods run (start), it takes subtasks, and it can be reordered, saved and restored.

**Fixed in core:** a type no code had imported used to fall back to a plain Item in the browser. Now the page loads it first (`Item.modules`).

add.title: Open the Task by itself
add.text: Every card has its own address: /live/<id>/

add.title: ✅ Removed cards are kept
add.text:
**Your worry:** a removed card survives only in the log, and a compaction would lose it.

**Today nothing is lost.** No log is ever shortened, snapshots are a separate cache file, and pages are never snapshotted.

**Built anyway:** a remove or clear moves the card into the page's **removed** list, which is part of the saved page. `{"restore":"<id>"}` brings a card back.

add.title: ✅ ask_mastermind is deprecated
add.text:
It started a separate Opus voice-session agent for each call, with its own reply files and tickets.

Voice now hands work over with **spawn_agent + send_to_agent**, and replies arrive through **updates**. Removing its code is queued.

**Servex needs a restart** for voice to see this. Pick a time between calls.

add.title: ⬜ Still open
add.text:
**Moving a screen to another page** (a different file) has no tool yet. Within one page, cards and screens move freely.

**A refused call is still logged:** completing a Task that has open subtasks writes a line and reports ok, though nothing changes.

open-task.text: Every card has its own address: `/live/<card id>/`

add.title: Every card is a page
add.text: Tap this card. It opens at /live/lab/is-page/, and voice writes there with the same deltas as /live/.
This line lives **inside** the card: `item({path: "/live/lab/is-page/", delta: {content: {add: …}}})`. It is saved in /live/lab/page.jsonl; no new folder.

add.title: And deeper
add.text: Cards inside cards, at any depth: /live/lab/is-page/deeper/.
